title: Glorified Bodies
definition: Glorified bodies are the transformed, imperishable bodies believers will receive at the resurrection.
summary: Believers will not remain under weakness, decay, pain, or death forever. God will complete redemption even in the body.
christFocus: Christ's glorified resurrection body is the pattern and guarantee of the believer's future transformation.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Believers will not remain under weakness, decay, pain, or death forever. God will complete redemption even in the body.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, understand Scripture clearly, and live with hope, obedience, and discernment.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, endurance, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
